description: Tap the screen for real (an OS touch: CoreDevice on the iOS Simulator, the way Xcode sends it, or idb on older Xcode; adb on Android), for native-only controls like a native tab bar or a system dialog, or when tap_element finds no handler. Pass holdMs for a long press. label and x/y work even when the app's JS is stuck.

allowBuoy.description: Touch even if Buoy's own panel covers the spot. By default the tap stops there, because it would hit Buoy instead of the app.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

holdMs.description: Hold the touch this long: a long press (context menus, Paste, reorder handles). 600 is a typical long press.

label.description: Native accessibility label, e.g. "Rewards" for a native tab.

query.description: Text of an element from describe_screen.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

name: native_tap
